## Highlights
### New
- Return to Saved URL sends a pinned or saved tab you've moved away from back to its saved address, from the Tabs menu, the command palette, or keys you choose in Settings › Shortcuts. Thanks to @hader00. - Turn on Show sidebar when switching Spaces with shortcuts in Settings › Appearance, and a hidden sidebar slides out for a moment when you change Space from the keyboard, so you can see where you landed. Thanks to Mathias Balling (@MathiasBalling). - Turn on Ask before quitting in Settings › General, and Command-Q or Quit Crest asks first, with Don't ask again to stop asking. Thanks to Mael Bigay (@mTxBeN).
### Improved
- A folder you make from a tab's menu opens with its name ready to type, as New Folder in the sidebar does. A new saved folder opens the saved section first, so its name is in view. Thanks to Sunny Tamang (@SunnyTamang). - While a Peek is open, the address field shows the Peek's address, and its lock, Copy URL button and Site Controls are for the Peek's page. When the Peek closes or becomes a tab, the field shows the tab's address again. Thanks to Jared Volpe (@plainspace).
### Fixed
- When Crest is already connected to as many agents as it takes, another agent is told so and can try again later, instead of being told that Crest isn't running. Thanks to Nir Cohen (@nircoh-onyx). - In Settings › Tabs, the note about holding Shift sits under Switch to tabs opened from links, the only setting it changes. Thanks to Miguel Villalobos (@MotherJammer). - Typing “settings” in the command palette lists Settings pages, and a phrase such as “privacy settings” finds its page. Thanks to Anna Danchenko (@aodanchenko). - The command palette no longer selects a row that appears under a resting pointer, so Return opens the row the keyboard chose. Moving the pointer still selects the row under it. Thanks to Miguel Villalobos (@MotherJammer). - With Reduce Transparency on, a Space's sidebar texture shows as a fine film grain instead of all but disappearing, and the Texture slider previews it the same way. Thanks to Peppe Bergqvist (@peppelorum).

## Highlights
### Improved
- Search fields in Settings, the sidebar's lists, folder previews and the icon and symbol pickers share one look, show a focus ring while you type, and have a clear button that highlights under the pointer. - The developer toolbar's buttons, the extension side panel's close button and the engine choices in Settings highlight under the pointer like Crest's other controls, and disclosure arrows in site settings and Privacy point the right way in right-to-left languages. - The sidebar's update and Now Playing cards, the translation bar and the symbol and emoji pickers use Crest's standard buttons, with the same hover and press highlights as the rest of Crest. - Reviewing a password import shows the Space's crest and lays the totals, accounts, warnings and rejected rows out in Settings-style groups, with each row number tagged in its warning or error colour. - Renaming a Space in place shows Crest's field with a focus ring, and its pencil highlights under the pointer. - Link routes in Settings sit directly in their group instead of a box inside it, the URL pattern uses Crest's field with a focus ring, and the route actions button highlights under the pointer.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
